notes.title: Goose Lodge Bingo and Gaming Center Grand Opening!
notes.content:
March 29th 2025

Update #031 
Version: V0.9992
Build# 000000000

Summary:
- Grand Opening of the Goose Lodge Gaming and Casino area.
- New Bingo game system against Islandville bots. Play 1-3 cards.
- New Quick Ripps. Fun lotto card rippers in 3 different values.
- New Slot Machine. Wild Goose Chase.
- New Slot Machine. Islandville Jackpots with free spin Bonus system. 
- Bug Fixes: Game saving bug fixes.
- Bug Fixes: Lighting fixes at the beach and One Eye'd Billies indoors.
- Added new controller support for Lotto and New Quick Ripps.

Hello arcaders! it's update time! This update introduces the new Goose Lodge indoor location, 3 new gaming machines, Quick Ripps and a complete bingo system. I will be rolling out this new Goose Lodge indoor location in 2 phases (like I have done with all new locations). This gives me a chance to try some things on a smaller scale and adjust after I get more player feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/8408a94effe0d5c8ddf93faed60e1067d50df542.jpg

The largest part of this new update is the Bingo game system inside of the Goose Lodge. I really tried to capture the small town community Bingo hall in all of its "glory". Many people drive by Bingo halls on a daily basis and will never step foot into one of them. So now The Coin Game offers a way to fill your digital lungs with all that small town Bingo goodness. So get in there and grab an uncomfortable chair at a wobbly folding table and get to work!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/41b81aa64445bfc36e3a6a8889eaaff4f67b0e74.jpg

After you insert your players card in the machine/table (next to purple mohawk Rhonda in the middle of the room) you can choose from 1-3 Bingo Cards. They are $2.50 per card/per game. As the Bingo caller calls out the randomly drawn numbers you must mark them on your bingo cards with a blue "dab" (or dot). If you match 5 in a row before all of the other bots, you win the whole pot. You can see the value of the game you are playing on the Goose Lodge wall monitor (see below images). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d7c20e9734a01f68b9a5e5aff969285c362ffaa6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/099e77e98e4470e160a90c8ee0a19620c31b5843.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/933ee61bf4ce9d01400dfe025b39f56086e8ca01.jpg

The center spot of all cards is a free spot and will start each game as already "dabbed". You must have the called numbers "dabbed" (clicked showing a blue dot) on your bingo card for the "bingo" win to count. If the bingo is good and called before the other bots, the payout staff will come to your table and pay you out in cash. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/376e98e61d9027fe2724751e21387521eb80fa4d.gif

Throughout phase 1 there will be some dust and boxes laying around the Goose Lodge as Gary is still setting up his new business. No, not the adorable but annoying Swan-Goose Gary... the other Gary. What's that? You don't know Gary? Oh forgive me. Gary is the bot who's "head" glitters like a Bass boat and the one who still wears his bowling shirt and shoes from the 90's. He is the owner of the Goose Lodge and you will most likely find him in his "mini-casino" area just off the bingo gaming floor.  A few years ago Gary bought a bunch of old slot machines from a swap meet and has been retro-fitting them to be able to played with your players club card. He will be testing and adjusting the machines all day and night until he gets it right. The guy is a psycho about numbers and providing a fun and fair experience to all his patrons. So give him a break if they need some adjustment later down the line. ;) He said they are just for charity and that he donates all the money to Rusting/Aging Bots in the community. The slots will pay out in cash right on you players card.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/71b2627ca96fd54774901a854cccf1ae28ea660d.jpg

Over the past few months I have been building these new slot machines along side of updating the project to Unity 2022 game engine (more info on that later). They have really been a blast to make. I love the mechanics of slot machines and had ideas of adding them years ago but never got around to it as there is still so many arcade machines to add. I could not put them off anymore though as MANY players have been asking for them since day one. Thank you for being patient and I am glad to finally put in serious time and make them as good as I can for you. Let me know what you think of them. As someone who loves all things analog and tactile... I had to do old fashioned "reels" type slot machines. I love the clunk and noises of the turning wheels. It really can be a fun rush to hit a free spin bonus. 

The first slot machine is called Wild Goose Chase. It is a "Wild card" style slot. It is a single payline machine. You can wager 1-3 credits by using the left joystick (or A and D Key on keyboard) to increase or decrease the bet. Press the interact button to spin the reels and let the magic happen. All possible payouts are listed on the top panel of both machines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/7653e16f5dbccfeee33d88752c2740e4940a3ac9.jpg

The second slot machine is called Islandville Jackpots. It is a Free Spin bonus style slot machine. It is also a single payline machine. You can wager 1 or 2 credits. The object is to get as many Jackpot Logos as possible on the single payline. Payouts are on the top of both machines. If you hit all three of the bonus logos the machine will enter a bonus mode. After you match 3 bonus values of free spins the machine will enter auto mode and spin until all of your free spins are gone. Depending on the value that you matched you could 1x, 2x or even 3x your whole spin bonus! Remember. Gary said that these are just for fun and charity to fix the pot holes around Islandville and stuff. Also, there are no leaderboards or tickets dispensed from the slot machines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/58324e9d183efd1ea63b6b28767470a6e47732ff.jpg

The third machine in the Goose Lodge that I have added is a Quick Ripps lotto dispenser. It sells small lotto cards that are inspired by the Pull Tabs you can find in many Bingo halls around the US. I thought they were a great addition to the "small town casino" style theme that I have built into the Goose Lodge. You basically pick the value of the Ripper that you want and buy them. Rip the covers off the values and hopefully reveal a winner. They are pretty simple but a ton of fun to rip. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/dc2703d40ba71e4a2e1922fd5ff679782b7b60eb.jpg

If you get hungry in the Goose Lodge there is always popcorn and snacks available 24/7. The Lodge never closes, so feel free to drop in and try your luck anytime of the day or night!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ddcc222433f1eb8d8097ad02e6c34cbeacaa8639.jpg

That about does it for this content update. Thank you VERY MUCH for supporting The Coin Game. It has been almost 6 years since launching this goofy idea and I am forever grateful that I get the privilege to work on this title for you.


IMPORTANT NOTE: The Goose Lodge update is new content and new machines only. It does NOT contain any of the optimizations that I am working on for the new Unity "2022" version of The Coin Game that is coming later this summer. Those optimizations will come in one of the next updates of 2025. Long story short... the hiccup/stutter/glitch is still there and we must work around it for just a LITTLE longer. Trust me though... I have played the updated version and its all gone. Smooth as butter. I cant wait to get it to all of you sometime this summer. There is just so much to do still. Its not something that just gets done in a month or two. We are going on 6 months and still have a couple more to go. THANK YOU For your patience and understanding. 


If you love The Coin Game and want to see more... you can help me out by leaving the game a good review on the Steam Store page. It makes a huge difference for a single indie dev like myself.

Thank you. 

"devotid"
Kevin

notes.title: Quick Dev update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/011de26242ebc10b4b25d2acf381b9a1bfefe184.jpg

Quick Dev Update for the Goose Lodge Bingo Hall. 

First off... I want to extend a warm welcome to all the new Islandville residents! We are honored to have you here enjoying some ticket redemption fun of the 90's with us! I really believe that 2025 is going to be the best year yet for The Coin Game. 

I have been busy finishing the Goose Lodge Bingo game content update and also working with a new team to upgrade the source project to a new version of Unity 2022. long story short... I underestimated the task of upgrading a 150GB project to a newer version of the Unity engine halfway through multiplayer development. Hey I'm learning here!

The current roadmap is to release this Goose Lodge update around the end of March. If all goes as planned, this March Goose Lodge update "should" be the last update with the old version of Unity (2018). The newer Unity (2022) version that myself and the team are currently working on in the background runs much better and has all but fixed the garbage collection "glitching" problems that we have been facing for years. We still have a couple months of work to do to convert all the other input systems and game saving systems to the new engine but Unity (2022) will be worth the wait. 

Enough about the boring stuff Kevin... where's the beef?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c10d8b50ac2408b3ff51155448fa825ffce143dd.jpg

So... The next content update will focus on the inside of the Islandville Goose Lodge. It will include a complete Bingo Gaming hall where you can compete against the local Islandville Bots in a "professional" Bingo game. Keep track of your numbers called with an "ink dabber" and then scream BINGO when you have a row of 5 Dabs. It sounds pretty simple... but can get crazy fast. Stay focused and get lucky and you can walk away with some nice loot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/5d4cb63ff35bd273c3bdec4fce3391216152ac38.jpg

You will be able to play with multiple cards and have to be patient to beat the bots. I mean.. they are robots after all. I am working on a couple more small surprise machines in the Goose Lodge as well but we will have to wait to find out what those are. ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/840403410242fc37eff9f0225553bced3a715e1f.jpg

As I have said before I can't rush this process of upgrading the source project files. It must be done. The end quality of the game is just as important as adding shiny new features. So THANK YOU for being patient with me and my new team as we go back and fix dumb mistakes I made years ago building it.

That's about it for this small Dev News update. I will have even more info when the Goose Lodge Bingo hall comes out but I just wanted to touch base and let you all know a little more about the future roadmap. 

Thank you for your support of The Coin Game!

Kevin

notes.title: Tis the Season! Fun Holiday decorations update!
notes.content:
HO HO HO! Hello Islandvillers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/04bfacf80bc213e290d55fcd5936f6e3beabb6b3.jpg

I had a chat with Jerry Bot while filling up the family van last week and he said he told all the bots around Islandville that we needed to up the "festive cheer" this year. He said he cant be the only one who loves the holidays and they all agreed. So Jerry, Barry and the worker bots went crazy last week and decorated the whole island. True story. 

I actually wanted to do this last year but I was busy cramming in the water park, so there was just not enough time. This year, I went all out and put up Christmas decorations all around the island. I hope you like it. I had an absolute blast making it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/e01403e60370bb839b4da858396a01b2fb26e646.jpg

I always loved small town pole decorations and also when businesses would put a huge Santa sleigh on the roof. The cheesier the better. I had to throw in a couple of those.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/bb9731aff4f9317dea413c8ed5238973ea898f0d.jpg

Barry organized all the Main Street lights that are overhead, and also went a little overboard on his pawn building. He loves this time of year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/b4e03737af4be6ea31f8e7c8380a33ad1f61a1a5.jpg

Everyone has that one neighbor that just LOVES this time of the year. Haha. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/6144435c61b042259443d12278629183f9de3fba.jpg

So thats about it. Just some fun ambiance for the holiday season. Take a cruise in the Mini Van and enjoy the smooth Christmas tunes on the radio (R Key) while you take in the islands decorations. This update is just for fun and will be temporary for the holiday season. After this I will be working on the next location (Goose Lodge) and I will also be working with the new coding team to bring The Coin Game into a newer version of Unity. It's going to be a LOT of work but the game deserves it!

See you all next year. Thank you again for supporting The Coin Game, and don't forget to support your LOCAL arcade!

Merry Christmas.

Kevin

notes.title: The Coin Game Fall content update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/abc7d3e79ea0777b00ce7ff123de1dbf35be10f6.jpg

Update #029 
Version: V0.9990
Build# 000000000


Greetings fellow Islandvillers! It's update time! This is the first update working with my new partners and all I can say is... So far. So Wonderful! They are showing me more opportunities for the game than I even knew existed. We are going to build great things together. That I know. I now have the ability to just work on the GAME. It's amazing. (I mean... I even have a teammate that checks my speling and grammer. I prob don't need it thuogh.) So BIG THANK YOU to the Kwalee team. Well Barry's in the background yelling at me right now "Enough suit talk junior... lets get to the gravy!". So here we go.

This update brings one new vehicle, a couple of new games, a couple of new locations, a programmable nanny bot and some good old fashion bug fixing. I made sure to spend some time fixing older bugs that were haunting players for years. I am really striving to make the game better and not just bigger. But hopefully there will be no more bicycles on the roof of Jerrys. I see players are exchanging strats in the discord on how to fetch their bikes from the roof. If you haven't checked out the discord I recommend it. Lots of fun and some great islandvillers in there. The Coin Game memes alone are worth it. 

This updates features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/fbe432aad1ffcc527f8e5229b2a1bcd79d335764.jpg

- Nanny Bot is now programmable just like Stinky Jimmy the Junkman and Skippy the Scout newspaper bot. If you are playing survivor mode, the old bucket of bolts can be programmed to go shopping for you and Gary. You must have $20.00 in your ICU Savings account for the program to work. If you have the money, click on her yellow button on her back and she will "open up" with a key pad. Then you can enter the 4 digit code into the key pad and she will deliver the goods to your kitchen counter. She is not the fastest but she gets great deals from Jerry on items as they come from the same bot manufacturing plant. She will probably complain a little but she just doesn't like to be away from her Gary. If you program her and then go to sleep in survivor mode, she will have your goodies in the morning on the table. Remember that to program a "programmable" bot you simply click the back round yellow button on them and then click the key pad when it rotates out. Then you can enter the 4 digit code. It will give an error if you don't have the money in your savings or the code is entered wrong. The programmable bots rear LED will be green when in "default" mode and Nanny Bot will be purple when she is doing a job or in "program" mode. You can cancel a program with code 0000. I don't know why you would do that but I coded it in. lol. Just in case. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/88d124b7d8d60c2435ef8e93ecfc14379f633b1a.jpg

- I added a Used Family Mini Van for sale in Jerry's parking lot. $1800 is a steal for a unit like this. It's a little faster to travel around Islandville. It also has a few planned features which are not yet finished. The van will make cruising with friends possible in Multiplayer someday but for now it is just another option to cruise around with. It takes a little more gas but it is much faster than the bike or the golf kart. Make sure to check the gas gauge when you buy it... Jerry has been known to sell cars with little to no gas in them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4e9e572ce9a7c626bd95b2ebb36ba50ed12cf1e2.jpg

- There is a radio in the Van (R key) or (Left D Pad) on controller to turn it on or off. For now, it's really simple and has no other features yet. It just plays the local radio and if you turn the radio on and off it will skip to the next song.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/dc5999b5a8edc358dba716ce9899a4bd4a4419b2.jpg

- New PAY LOAD Coin Dump game at the Mall Arcade. One of my favorite games in the real world. Inspired by the classic coin ramp game "Big Rig Truckin". Line up the ramp and time it just right to win big tickets. Get it in the bucket... 10 tickets. Hit the dump lever or through the bonus hoops and win BIG on just a single $1. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ba2f71563813584d664867eef28f4214a216036b.jpg

- I added a shady "Shell Game" behind Barry's pawn shop. Who doesn't love a good street artist? Well I guess you could call it that. When the limo driver is not dragging Islandville brats around the town, he is making a little extra money behind Barry's pawn shop. You can wager some cash and if you pick the correct cup after he shuffles them up you will win double your money back. Make sure to keep your eye on the red ball... but it's kind of impossible as he is a robot and is faster than you think. Good luck. You are going to need it. Make sure to keep your head on a swivel so you don't get beat up by the bad bots while you are on their turf. Oh I almost forgot. For you big gamblers...you can also go ALL IN and risk it all for the ultimate double up. Make sure to have some back up cheesy poofs to get home though if things don't work out. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/b18efbbd8fa8b1cd0a6722debcec64b6320017f5.jpg

- Added more "construction" zones to the island to show some of the future building sites. The bots are always working in the background.

notes.title: Dev Update & Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Hey Islandvillers. It's been a minute since I have posted a dev update. I am sorry about that and the lack of info but I had to wait until I had more news to bring you all up to speed on the changes happening behind the scenes here at The Coin Game.


You see... when I started this game 6 years ago I never would have suspected it would be this large and impactful. In the beginning, it was just a fun art project meant to play an old coin pusher from my local county fair as a kiddo. I then put it on Steam Greenlight and people voted it in pretty quickly. Here we are 6 years later and there is an entire island full of arcades, jobs and lots of silly bots. I never would have thought it would be this big and slowly over time I came to the reality that Uncle Phil and devotid would need some professional outside codesmiths to take this game to the next level.


So I decided around Mar/April of this year to buck up and seek outside partnerships and hire some smarter people than me. As a stubborn do-it-ALL-yourself kind of person that was very hard to face but the game is so much bigger than me now and it had to be done. It's taken months and lots of work to find the right help/partners for The Coin Game but I have found the right partners. Remember... I am a game developer, not a business suit, so this is something I have had to learn along the way.


Also...Side note. HUGE THANKS to Steam for building the Greenlight and Early Access programs and allowing me to build this title. Without the Steam Greenlight incubation system in place, I wouldn't have had the chance to even build this game. 


I can't say too much yet but it will bring The Coin Game to a new more professional level that it deserves. I have dropped the ball when it comes to the games "socials" and general interaction with the community. I am so busy coding, modeling and running the backend that it is near impossible to react to all the needs of the front end. So with this, I’m happy to announce that I’ve teamed up with UK-based publisher Kwalee!


This new team-up will help me with my day-to-day tasks while ensuring I have creative control and freedom over The Coin Game. The team over at Kwalee will be supporting me with marketing, production, and anything else in the future.
Together, we will improve the quality of life for the residents of Islandville! So, keep an eye out for more to come in the future.


Thank you for being patient during this time and thank you for supporting The Coin Game!


Kevin

notes.title: Christmas at Lenny's WaterPark and New Mall Cinema!
notes.content:
Hey Islandvillers!

First off, I want to say thank you and welcome to all the new Islandvillers that have joined us this year. Without all of you NONE of this would be possible. So THANK YOU from the bottom of my heart. Your support allows me to do this full time and I am very grateful. I am also very excited for the new year coming.... as I really feel that 2024 is going to be the best year yet for The Coin Game. For now lets get to the new update.

This update is a little thing I have been working on in the background for a few months along side of the regular stuff I have been working on (Mall, Optimizing and Multiplayer.. etc). I have always wanted to add some kind of water attraction to the island and I finally got it done enough to share with all of you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/2aee0af435eb6e314c7fbb7c24f320e02fef74ba.jpg

WATERPARK:

New Lenny's Water Wonderland Waterpark. It's all new and located near the Beach on the East side of the island. The new waterpark is complete with Waterslides, Wave pools, Dunk Tanks and of course a lazy river to just relax at the end of a hard arcade bender. It is open 24 hours a day... Seven days a week and the best part is that it is FREE to all Islandville residents (yes that's you).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/dc008ee8922ead1d96ee605d1eac7b348ffd3b9e.jpg

To ride the Lazy River just head into the entrance and click on the single yellow innertube that is at the edge of the Lazy River under the awning. You will be loaded automagically. You can rotate the tube by paddling with your hands left and right. Nice and lazy... Just like its supposed to be. Let the waterfalls splash off your forehead as you plan your next payday at the pawn shop. You will auto exit at about the same location after completing a full "lap". Its actually very relaxing. haha. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1b8b7974f48cd3848bea922b9a3ed5de8a7324cf.jpg

To ride the two waterslides just walk to the top of the stairs and you will see 4 tubes at the top. Two on the right and two on the left. Click on one of them to choose right or left side. Single or double tube. Single tube is just you alone on a tube and double is when you go plummeting with a bot friend in a two seat tube. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/aa3f522ffc07df714a4ef9648bd992766e1b8eb8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/7cf7a73e367432f172e33f5406d4e9fc59249c31.jpg

You can exit any "ride" at the waterpark by hitting the E Key (Or exit button with a controller).

Here's Lenny the Mascot. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/a2403cc4d163231844421c7e93960cc4a67eefc2.jpg

The Wave pool has a simple physics system on it that will "surf" you up to the beach if you are in the waves "pocket". It is still a WIP and will change to be a little more advanced in the future. Currently the floating bots are animated but I really want to be able to interact more with them in the future but for now I wanted them in the mix bobbing around. They look pretty happy to me. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d3f771e9ed857960cfb0e9f96178bd97712ba778.jpg

You will notice that there is a Dunk Tank at the front of Lenny's Waterpark. Barrys is currently collecting a donation for the kids. Its 3 bucks a shot to try to dunk him in a pool of Mineral Oil. (water will make him rust). If you dunk him... his helper will get you a "nice" prize for participating. So it could pay off or it couldnt. You never know with my man Barry. But its for the kids. Right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/593dae952673a486e616b92ecec84861b64df4e6.jpg



CINEMA:

The mall theater is complete and ready to watch movies from your hard drive. You can also purchase food goodies from the concession stand located in the Islandville Cinema. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1214df2e42575dab7e09356a0bae8255f18357a5.jpg

Loyd and Evan are great employees at the cinema and always keep the place looking sharp. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/a63c5428fd45fc3756c46dfea9c1c46361010b7b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/8183b364666abac509aedc060cb2181e6f439424.jpg

TO watch a movie from your hard drive. Place an .Mp4 video in your Documents\devotid\TCG_Videos folder. For now it will only play the first video in the folder. In the future you can watch back to back movies but for now one is the limit at a time. You may need to create the "TCG_Videos" folder if you have not already. Once the file is in place... you can just purchase one "indie film" spot from the theater kiosk and the countdown on the wall next to the pricing will start. Take your seat and the movie will start automatically. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d39ea669eeae528d35d501f5be4f53bac31c7295.jpg

To choose a seat just stand in front of it and click on it. Hit the Exit button (E Key) to stand up. Its pretty simple. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/7beafb611451edba0e93be39c65f7bf847c0624e.jpg

I am still making a short film for the "Feature Film" at the theater but it is not done yet. Turns out to be a 1000x harder than I thought to make a small short movie. I will add it to a future update. It will work about the same as the Indie films.

Note: The "fastest" output size for the Mp4 Videos is around 800x480 (Windows phone size) I did some HD ones... but it wasnt really needed in that high of resolution. I use the old Windows Movie Maker to convert old videos to Mp4 format.


NEW COIN DROP GAME at Jerrys in the Mall food court:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/f78073b7f3951f822d19f4c59637c08ee30136cb.jpg

I just had to add one of theses... so I talked Jerry into getting a Coin Drop game. It was pretty tough to get it right with a lower frame rate of the mall. It took some grinding on optimizing of the mall to get it to work. I think I spent about 2 full weeks on just the "feel" of the game. Its such a simple thing in real life but can be so challenging to model in a game and make it feel right. I am glad I did it though as the game is really fun.

The idea of the drop game is to make the coin land on the lowest platform of the spinner and BOOM. One free Gourmat Tuna Sammich from Jerry (a $7.50 value). Limit of 3 per day. After you win 4 sammys, Jerry will make up some fake story about the thing being "dirty" and needed to be cleaned... but we all know thats just code for "you're winning too much kid". He will eventually turn it back on because its good for business.


That's about it for the update stuff. I will have more news after the new year. 


KNOWN ISSUES:

- Added a nudging tool to the Pumpkin Pusher Orange Balls on the winner ramps. They were getting stuck pretty bad. 
- Christmas is on at the Mall and Jerrys Gas and Go. Go see Santa Bot!

- Fixed the leaderboards on larger High Res monitors. 
- Fixed the zombie Hands walking bug that would happen after using the Pause/ESC Menu button when in the golf cart. 
- Removed the pinball machine from One Eyed Billies for performance reasons. You can still play it in the Islandville Market store. 
- Movies at the Cinema are indie only for now. The fun short film I am working on is not completed yet but I wanted to test the system out before then. The current system will only play the "first" movie in the TCG_Videos folder. So name it accordingly, as the system will grab them alphabetically.
- Only supports 10 video "spots" total in the TCG_Videos Folder. WIP
- Only plays one video for now. The first one in the folder. 
- Fixed Garys Water dish and the fish food level GUI bleeding through everything. 
- Nerfed the return Pawn $ value of four food items from Jerrys. Apparently Berry has been buying back the food items that Jerrys is selling for 100% value. Dont know how Barry stayed in business for so long. What a man of the community though. Huh? 
- 6 Pack of batteries is now $0.50 at the pawn shop.

Thank you again for the support and dont forget to leave us a good review if you like the game. It makes a big difference for an indie dev.

Kevin

"Pumpkin Pusher" marble coin pusher: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/97a01e009017753f6c080bd3a388f381057a76de.jpg

The newest coin pusher at Arcade Castle in the mall is a marble style of "coin pusher". It has two different sizes of marbles. The smaller white "Ghost" balls and orange "Pumpkin" scoring balls.

The idea of the game is to drop the white marbles through the pins on the gameboard into the 7 different traps. As each white marble is dropped through the traps you will see the lights illuminate and count above them. Once you illuminate all of the lights on one side or the other, you will enter "Pumpkin Party" Mode. The right side of the gameboard offers free tickets and the left side of the board offers more free ghost balls dropped onto the pusher table.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/2c349c17dbb65d243f5a57f528908ba9353f7972.jpg

But the best part of the Pumpkin Party mode is that when you drop the Orange Pumpkin balls off the edge (These are won by hitting the orange middle trap on the gameboard) you have a chance to win the large Jackpots on the right side bonus wheel. Once the Pumpkin Party timer runs out you can no longer win the Jackpots with the right side spinning wheel and must re-light all the center gameboard traps again to enter the bonus mode. You can still score big tickets with the orange balls on the right side spinner during non Pumpkin Party time but you can ONLY win the jackpot during Pumpkin Party time. So be sure to save some ghost balls to drop during the bonus round that will push the orange balls over during the Pumpkin Party bonus. 

Whew! that was a mouth full and sounds confusing. haha. I think its just easier to play and learn as you WIN BIG!

Insert your card and use the standard game controls to move the UFO crane around and once you have it in the desired position simply click the interact button to drop the UFO claw. If the item is grabbed and knocked off the platform you win. Upon winning, the machine will automagically drop a new item in a new location for you to try to win another one.

Public Restroom Hangout area:
You know what to do. Grabs granny purse and hit the scratchers in secret. She will thank you when you hit the big one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4fd580c5765666136964a3dd0ceebc22bd2404f9.jpg


Survivor Mode updates:

New Islandville Credit Union Banking system:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d5417af9d55fe04087617c09bf0929bc2810f09d.jpg

I built a new banking system for some "bigger" and "different" purchases that are coming to Survivor mode. ;) The bank is called Islandville Credit Union and is conveniently located all over the island with walk up ATMs. This is a different money account from the Players Club Card/Wallet that you currently have on you. This is now another separate way to pay for things that dont accept the players card. I will explain below.

This new bank account will be used to pay programmable worker bots for "services" and for making "larger purchases" that are coming at a later date. The first two worker bots are old school "Uncle Phil era" programmable bots. The first two characters names are Stinky Jimmy and Scoop the news bot. They are old V1 versions and do not accept your fancy "Players Club Cards". You see, these bots were built in a time when the Players Club Cards didnt exist in Islandville yet. Uncle Phil was still building the early framework and had not nailed down a payment system for all these new modern ticket arcade machines. He eventually decided on the Players Club Card for most things as that was what all the "cool arcades" were using. So going forward in Survivor Mode you will need both payment systems for different reasons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/668dcb6d9172e8251796829cc2b23709de6094ad.jpg

To deposit money into your savings account simply insert your card into one of the ATM machines around the island and choose how much to deposit or withdrawal. Its pretty simple. You can see the account balance on the game screen (Little Locked Chest looking Gray Icon) and also on your watch menu. Being the classy Uncle that Phil is he started you out with $10 smackeroos in there to save towards programming bots or to withdrawal and waste on games. its your call. For now the ATMs are located next to the Islandville Market, in front of the UFO Arcade and inside the new Islandville Mall.

TLDR: I am using the programmable bots as a way to introduce the new bank account system. The bank account will be used to purchase other items and features in the future.


Programmable Bots:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/53f0b73f1ac539b00089482c225de49a733e345b.jpg

Programmable bots are something that Uncle Phil thought you could use to make the survival day a little easier. Who wouldnt want a bot friend that will work for peanuts? Now there are a couple bots around the island that do just that. They will have a small yellow button on their lower backs. When you approach a programmable bot they will stop moving like normal and then you can click on them to grab them and throw them around... if that is your thing. But if you click the button again you will notice the mouse cursor change from the grab to the interact cursor. Their outer case open up and a numerical keyboard will pop up on screen. If you have enough money in your savings account you can then input 4 digit codes to program these old school bots. For now each bot only has one program to run but more jobs and functions will come later in development.

Stinky Jimmy:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ee5cbaa3d78927f838e536d114845cb0c5649398.jpg

Stinky Jimmy is a Islandville OG. He landed day one on the maiden voyage with Uncle Phil, Gary and One Eyed Billy. Duder was born with a shovel in his hand. He is not afraid of hard work and it shows on his rough and dented composite laminated shell. Dont let the flies around him fool ya... he is never stagnant. Catch him behind the Islandville Market in his "office". He is ready to be programmed to work. Currently Stinky Jimmy is available to program/hire for a "Dumpster Junking route". This entails Mr Jimmy checking all the local dumpsters around town in one route. He will return the found items behind his office dumpster for you when he has collected them all. Remember Jimmy is old school and only accepts bank transfers... so you must have the fee he is asking in your Islandville Credit Union Account or the 4 digit program will fail. Since Jimmy is an absolute junking pro, he gets deep into the boxes and bags hidden in the corners and finds the good loot you didnt know was there. That means he leaves plenty of dumpster items untouched for you the player to find later when you need them most. So go say hi to Jimmy today and put him to work! Uncle Phil's orders. 

Scoop the news bot:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/a5765cb6b96ab4720e2a5901d660157e40af282c.jpg

Scoop is another early version bot that Uncle Phil built shortly after arriving on the island. He is a young whippersnapper with go get em attitude just like Uncle Phil was in his youth. Ready to earn an honest dollar by rolling up his scout uniform and get things completed. He is found by the news stand. His only job so far is to complete one route of delivering papers. He will pay you all the money and rubber bands that you would normally get by doing it yourself when completed. He is so honest he doesnt even skim off the top. You can find his Scout Troop sponsored flyer with codes and prices displayed for programming on the News stand wall by the delivery van.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/01c773ed9b75262d43999e8f282d4c40f6c3f3f5.jpg

You can identify the current running program by the small LED on the backs of the programmable bots. below are the colors of identification. The programmable bots will also have their corresponding work hats on when on a task or being hired. When they are available for hire they will not have a hat on.

Stinky Jimmy:
Default Idle 		        = LED GREEN No hat
Programming Mode 	= LED YELLOW
Junking route 		        = LED BLUE Flashing with his cowboy hat on

Scoop news bot:
Default Idle 		        = LED GREEN with his favorite trucker hat on
Programming Mode 	= LED YELLOW
Newspaper Delivery 	= LED ORANGE Flashing with his news hat and newspaper bag on.



Summary of updates and optimizations:
- Optimized the newspaper delivery system to be zone based and not always on. This will save some load. 
- Optimized the Pizza delivery system mesh with a LOD system.
- Changed the update frequency on the Mini Map camera mover.
- Updated the Mini Map with "Mall" Location. The Limo/warehouse Fork Truck Area now go to the Mall entrance.
- Removed the money blower from the mall in survivor mode. Oops.
- Added more gas in the golf cart to start with. Now start with 25% instead of 11%
- Added a little cash to the birthday mode. You know start with $300. Uncle Phil's orders. 
- increased Volume distance on the Karts Racing.
- Golf cart is a little slower top speed.
- Golf cart gets a little better gas mileage now.
- Changed Cart audio wind noise.
- Added a light in the tree house
- added a interactive map of hidden loot boxes in the tree house that is unlocked with Zolbot Cards.
- Added Mall with arcade, food court and prize stores.
- Wishing well funnel for the aging bots. 
- New Pumpkin Pusher Machine
- New Crane game UFO Catcher
- ZolBot Fortune Teller
- Programmable bots
- Bank Account system
- Many more things to come in the mall. ;)

Thank you very much for supporting The Coin Game. I would not be able to make the game I that I love without you all and trust me... we still have plenty to build together. ;)

Kevin

Hello fellow Islandvillers! Tis the Season! 

I have a small last minute Christmas gift for you all!

I have uploaded a "Beta Preview" for the Holiday Season. The Beta password is christmasbeta.  I thought I would do this to show you all some progress of the next location in The Coin Game. I have been very quiet building and changing a lot of things for the next major update.... but I wanted to take a minute and put out a small BETA preview to show the new location with a little Christmas flare to it. As with any beta there may be bugs and it is not optimized in any way yet. This is just a small unfinished "peek" for the holidays. 

We all remember the "local mall" when we were young. Window shopping, crowded stores, Christmas music everywhere and of course getting your pic taken with Santa. If you grew up in the old days like me before cell phones and online shopping you would know that people actually went out to the mall just to hang out. No destination in mind except being seen and socializing with other shoppers during the holidays. I know... Sounds crazy right? As crazy as it sounds... It was wonderful and I hope you all enjoy my small simple rendition of it. The mall will change a bit through development as I still have many things to add.

When you are inside the mall there is no optimization zones yet, so all of the stores are on at once. 

Again.... This is a beta preview just to show off the new mall for the Holiday Season. Your old saved games will work but I advised you to start a new game with the beta.

Food Court:
Lemonista

Jerrys Gourmet Sammys

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/48a9d60ff713bf93d15d0c4d603493f4511c985a.jpg

Islandville Cinema:
The Islandville Cinema is NOT ready yet. When it is complete, it will be a fun nostalgic place to view movies (In the future you will be able to watch movies here with multiplayer friends.). I am still deciding on how this is going to work and I will have more on this as I figure it out. 

Old Empty Department Store:
This is saved for something funny in the future I have planned. I mean what else could go at an old large department store?

To play the beta... just opt-in to The Coin Game beta with password christmasbeta. To do so... Just right click on the game in your steam library and go to properties. Then click on Betas. Enter in the code christmasbeta and then click on Check Code. The Christmas Beta will show up as a button in blue. That will opt you into downloading the beta version. When you want to play the normal version just change the drop down in the betas tab again.  

The Beta version will install itself in the same game folder and work just like the main version. You should start a new game file with the beta. The beta will only be available for a limited time.

The password is christmasbeta

That about does it for the Christmas Beta Preview. I hope you all enjoy it. I will have more info and news about the full update and coming multiplayer after the new year. Thank you all for the support of The Coin Game and have a wonderful Holiday Season! 2023 is going to be our biggest yet. ;)

notes.title: Dev Update: New Islandville Mall Work in Progress pics
notes.content:
The Coin Game Dev Update:

First off I want to welcome all the new players and THANK you all for supporting The Coin Game! It has been a wonderful last few years and a dream come true to be able to build this game for you. We still have a long way to go though and I could not be more excited for the future of The Coin Game.

Its been a while since I have said anything on the next steps of The Coin Game. So lets get caught up. 

It saddens me to say but the multiplayer feature of the game is still on hold and going to take longer than I previously thought. So I have been finishing up more locations and new arcades in the mean time. I will share more info on the multiplayer delay when I have it. 

Here's what I am currently working on... 

(ALL PICS ARE WORK IN PROGRESS AND PRE LIGHTING/TEXTURING)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/40a9da6006b579a728aea4372f6e067c0722309a.jpg

Islandville is getting a MALL! That's right 100's of thousands of square feet of indoor shopping and loitering goodness! The coming Islandville Mall will feature many stores, funny new characters, a movie theater, a food court and a new "Arcade Castle" with new games and machines. The coming mall is inspired by 90-00's era shopping malls that are spread all around the US. This era was a time back when being "socially active" meant leaving the house to peacock around the local shopping center for "looks" and not "likes". Getting to play real arcade games as a kid was tough and it meant venturing out in to the great big world. You were risking it all on that crappy back tire of a borrowed neighbors sisters bike. But you took the chance an went for it. The mall was worth the ride...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/3131c1cda4790cc065fb38d387081b0677a3c791.jpg

The next arcade coming is influenced by the Alladin's Castle that was in my home town mall. I spent many days there. I would ride my bike 4-5 miles with friends and live off of hot pretzels and free ice water from the gracious clerk at the "gourmet" pretzel stand. Life was simple. The games were all pretty lame but we loved them. Maybe not as much as we loved shaving "steps: into the sides of our mullets but you get the idea.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/80e7828f406768f68b974129954233ae2184fab2.jpg

Over the last couple months I have modeled all the "structure" and parking lots of the mall and working on fitting it into the current map of Islandville. When I get it done and release it, it will be the largest location on the entire island. I am currently in the unwrapping process and will be texturing the new models soon. I will release more pics of the mall when I get some textures on it. This stage of development is never really that beautiful or interesting so I find myself not sharing much.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/62890ab776a76d925ea13b7a0a22b5d46f294e19.jpg 

Overall the mall is huge. haha. I always seem to go a little bigger than I planned... but I think it pulls the best out of me. I only ask for patience and understanding of how big of a one man project this is. This is just a taste of the new stuff coming. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/603602ddbf0ea1930d0f69628df78a4b2c9f6ece.jpg

Here are a couple pics of some of the new machines coming to the next arcade. Can you guess them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/52c1d70a5bb7244a01b6aac11d699cce477d4553.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/96502f1f771a020825c4e221ce3d3bc2ee4ccae3.jpg

Also... I want to thank everyone for being understanding and patient as I am a one man dev. Yeah... I could hire more help but this is my sole creation and I enjoy the grind of working on it. I appreciate all the supporters and fans allowing me to present my "art project" to the world the way I see it. That means a lot to me. So again. Thank you.

Kevin

notes.title: Winter Holiday UPDATE! New games, locations and jobs.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/65af482a687511fe5d432d980aac7a7c43b2ab41.jpg

This end of year holiday update brings new claw machines, new locations and even a new Pirate Pizza delivery job to earn more money around the island!

GENERAL NEWS

Thank you very much for all the support of The Coin Game!

Also... WELCOME to all the new players of The Coin Game! We are honored to have you and are VERY Thankful that you chose The Coin Game. Here at devotid... we take wasting your time very seriously. ;)

I have been working quietly in the background on this new update for a couple months (ok... more like 6 months). I am really glad to finally have it completed as my wife and I went through a large move over the last 5 months. We also had two very old Weiner doggies (16 and 17) that we spent precious last months with at our new home. All of this at once.... and no internet for 2.5 months made working on the project virtually impossible. It was also a really large job selling the old house but worth it in the end. We lived in our old home for 17 years. Its tough to leave a comfy familiar space and rebuild somewhere new. It took us about 2 years to find a nice quiet location..... but we are very lucky to have found a home in the woods. We now have a home office for us to continue working on The Coin Game were we get to stare at Gary's geese friends all day on the neighboring pond. Thank you again to all of The Coin Game supporters for helping me make this happen for my family. Without all of you NONE of this would be possible.

Silly to think that 6-7 years ago I was working part time at BestBuy installing car stereos, painting used cars in my driveway and making wakeskates at night in my garage... to now building the project of my dreams on Unity 3D. If you are passionate about games... Look into the wonderful community that Unity game engine has to offer. I could barely turn a computer on when I started this journey. Now I am more excited. More Empowered and even more inspired than I have ever been. And also.... Never give up. #indiegamedev


HOLIDAY UPDATE

Dec 22nd 2021
Update #024 
Version: V0.9943
Build# 7920670

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/559e80e7c53912f89b73e25f8377edeef7ffde7f.jpg

New Radio Controlled Sailboats:
One Eye'd Billies still had open area in the back... so I finished up the Radio Control Boat pond. Players can now earn tickets by piloting a wooden radio controlled sailboat around the pond and collect life rafts worth 50 tickets each. There is a time limit so be sure to hurry through all of the sea going traffic. If you get the minimum number of rings you will earn a 500 ticket bonus on top of your score.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/62aa01b76f1328975730627d5a2d6d5a70781ea6.jpg

This is a small replica of the old Radio Controlled boats from Cedar Point in Sandusky, Ohio. I had a blast playing with these as a child and would look forward to them all year. The boats were removed in the 90's and was VERY hard to find any pictures of info on them. The entire machine was modeled and built from one single old photo I found online. I hope it brings back great memories for others or makes new ones for those that couldn't be there. 




New Pizza delivery Job:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/d59e6cad9c14a2e18250c9b5ee640616bbb33d80.jpg

Now you can earn money delivering food to hungry islanders. Who didnt love delivering pizza pizzas as a job? Being your own boss... The open road... Pure freedom. The process is pretty simple. You buy pizzas with your own money. Put them into your inventory. Then just drop the pizza into the delivery box at each location with a light on the porch and also receive tip if you are fast enough. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4edec765c0a062a205a8908b3208d51036d644f6.jpg

summary: Purchase pizzas from the Pirate Pizza outdoor vending machine at One Eye'd Billies. Then you will see a countdown timer and a place appear on your watches mini map and also on the top left of the screen in red. Deliver any Pirate Pizza that you have to the location before the timer runs out to get paid, if you hurry you will get a nice tip from the local islanders. These delivery pizzas are not the ones from inside One Eyed Billies that you eat. Those are different and not packaged for delivery. You can not eat the delivery pizzas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/9dae814c4ec7860aa283ab4daf9a4306b966c99d.jpg

If you dont make it in time you can always sell the old pizzas to Barrys Pawn Shop for a little cash. There is a dozen locations spread around the map to deliver to. There is even a new subdivision out by the UFO arcade with 3-4 new houses. Good luck Matey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4caeefa866b7a4ccec6a20ac1172690f99686cf4.jpg



NEW GAMES at One Eye'd Billies:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c124945272566aa1ffd8553e6ce0171b5f15344a.jpg
- "Fishy fishy" is a regular style of claw machine that gives stuffed animals you can collect or trade for loot at Barrys. It works just like Dude Where's My Cow?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1f6c1a04976af627431538f3f6fcc42637923e04.jpg
- "Cash Claw" is a new scoop style claw machine (more of a crane bucket) that you attempt to scoop up cash and small prizes that are worth different amounts of money. If you win prizes in this machine the game will automatically add the money right to the players wallet and does not have to be "picked up" like other claw machines. This new machine is a work in progress and needs a little more optimization. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ebb0c6460032b516aaf35a78b32e54db93a64a3d.jpg
- "MegaDrop EXTREME!" It deserves ALL CAPS... because it is huge! Its is a similar version to the very popular Mega Drop that is currently at Larrrys Arcade but just way way bigger. Complete with the same catchy music. haha. Lets see those leaderboard scores... only bigger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/1893192ad892311376564da1e7f14e5f330a9ec3.jpg

- Moved a copy of the Pinball Machine and the Snow Ball Battle Arcade Game to One Eye'd Billies, It wasnt getting much play at the Dollar Store. Let me know what you all think. The pinball game has not been optimized yet for One Eye's Billie's and may be a little slow on frame rate. I get about 50-60 on a GTX2060/ i7. I have to add a few more controllers to OEB to finalize the install of it... but I thought I would sneak it in there for the Holidays. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/c52989f8f39a96ea8e8def75905cabcb45363d9a.jpg



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/699443949b35fe31c6b6ec76f5fba3822df7fe59.jpg
MISC updates and bug fixes:
- Added new audio for One Eye'd Billies prize counter character. YARRRRRGGGGHHHH!
- Added new audio for UFO arcade Price counter character. Space robots...
- Updated the Mini Map to show the recent locations and new subdivisions.
- Adjusted the mini map "zoom" to move farther away from the player to look around the map more. Currently you could not see the edges of the map when moving around.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/506c3d17525352be4be381996d3e4c55ea9d509b.jpg

- Added the onscreen GPS to the Bike to help delivering stuff to the destinations. Hit the "Tab" key on the keyboard or the watch button on the controller to view it while riding. 
- Fixed the Mini Map Player Icon from Wandering around on the mini map. It works a little more precise now. It also works a little better when in a cart or on a bike.
- update the button colors on the Player Transporter on the player watch.
- Fixed a bunch of the leaderboards not recording data.

That about does it for this surprise holiday update. I have a few more things I wanted to get into this update but I have taken long enough finishing up One Eye'd Billies. I am still working on the Co-op/Multiplayer, more optimizations and a BUNCH cool new areas and games coming to Islandville throughout 2022.

Thank you all again. Have a MERRY CHRISTMAS from devotid. 

Kevin

New Update is LIVE!

Update day!

I have finished a few new machines for One Eye'd Billie's, some fun shooting galleries and also some new achievements. And as always... as many bug fixes as possible.

ENJOY!

New Supporter Edition of the coin game is now available for $4.99 (Gold Watch, In game poster and other cosmetic items to help support The Coin Game.) Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1267250

And now for the update.

Combo Craze.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/812fa24b250e586542f26d64203ca0cd3670789b.jpg

It is a game of skill were you must stop the rotating line on the dot to crack the combination 50 times in a row. The increasing speed and rotating angles are a fun challenge to get just right. I really enjoy games at the arcade that are "mostly" skill based. They are also the easiest to code too as there are no algorithms to fandangle and tweak.

Popcorn Petes Pirate Plunder.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/4c890cf447cd1ff13fb876edbeb9fd7109ce1a73.jpg

Everyone loves Popcorn Pete! This new machine is a "plinko" style ball drop game. Press the button to fire a canon ball from the "SS Popcorn" and land in a treasure chest of tickets. It features a translucent LCD screen overlaid on the cabinets glass to give cool celebration graphics and counting screens. There is a center target that has a increasing bonus to win. Try your luck on the Popcorn Pete's Pirate Plunder game and win a boat load of tickets!

Pile Up.

- Added a (field of view) FOV slider to the main player camera. It adjusts from 45-90 degrees. The default FOV field is 70 degrees. The old game was always set to 70 degrees for reference. You can change it from the Options Menu. Under the Video settings. The game will auto save the setting.

- Added 7 New Achievements. "Treasure Hunter" for finding the loot crates. They are in values of 5, 10 and 20 total Crates. One for playing a round of 18 holes in mini golf. One for Babysitting the bots one time. One for mowing Barry's Lawn and One for getting a trophy at the UFO Kart race.

- Fixed hole #14 on the putt putt golf game.  Somehow the mesh got screwed up and was not letting golfers get over the small bump in the front of the hole. It is now changed and "playable". It's still not completely finished. Sorry for the mix up.

- Fixed the "Big Spender" Achievement not awarding when spending over 10,000 tickets on one item. It now works at all arcades.

- Added a plywood jump at the side of the carnival to get over the fence by the Bus stop. That way you dont have to walk all the way around to the front to enter. 

- Added a few "sand cubes" to the Treasure in The Sand game at Larrys Arcade. It should be possible to get a big win a little easier now. 

- Adjusted the colliders on the Machine next to Dunko as to not get the Warning form the interference system. When you would win more than one Dunko Duck it would fall into the machine next to it and set off a warning from Larry. He thinks you are sticking prizes into the machines and cheating. Some users lost some prizes because of it. It should not happen anymore. 

- Barrys HOT ITEMS will now reset each night when you go to sleep when you are in Survivor mode. When you are in Birthday mode it will reset after 1.5 hours of real time playing.

- Attempted to fix the Minnion bot grabbing you and slamming you into walls. It was happening after you would shoot one and they would run away or during a celebration... Then if you interacted with them as they were running away, they would get "connected" to you and send you flying all over the place. I have set it up now that they will not run into you and it should stop the player from getting thrown around. Still looking for more feedback on them. 

- I adjusted the Shoot the Star game at the Carnival and made it only give 2 credits for a win now. It used to be 3. Its now 33 percent more costly. 

- Fixed the pinball extra game knock sticking in a loop. 

- Fixed the Wormhole music turning off upon inserting players card. 

- Increased the Health value of Pirate pizza to 25 Points and the Pirate Punch to 10 Health Points. They are now equal with a cooked microwave dinner. 

- You can now get the Rasta Banana Achievement at the carnival games if you win it there. 

- Added a Microwave to the Dollar Store so you can cook meals AFTER you purchase them. Meals will not work in the microwave until you have purchased them. 

- Moved the Time of Day slider and Auto Time ON OFF button to the Main Player HUD on the screen instead of the wrist watch screen in Birthday mode. This way you can change the time of day easier to get the lighting and feel that you want. I dont think many people saw it on the watch and this should help a little with the confusion. This only works and is available in Birthday mode as Survivor is a locked auto time and can only be paused.

Well... that about does it for this update. Time for me to get back to working on even newer stuff ː1Quarter1Playː

Thank you for all the support and wonderful reviews. Without you none of this would be possible. Have a wonderful weekend!

Feel free to check out The Coin Game merch store here to help support development.

Kevin

Kevin

notes.content:
Hello fellow Islandvillers!

First off... THANK YOU for all the wonderful ideas, reviews and support for The Coin Game. Without all of you this game would not be possible.

One Eye'd Billie's Adventure & Fun Center:

I have been quiet.... but in typical devotid "workaholic never sleep" style I have been cranking night and day on the new locations, new features and new games. Here are some sneak peeks of One Eye'd Billie and his new Arcade. 

Thank you for being patient and understanding of what it takes to create this game as a solo developer. Its my own personal never ending fun project.... and I LOVE WORKING ON IT. 

The Next Update: One Eye'd Billie's new arcade will come in a couple stages. The first stage when finished will have about 9-10 new Machines. It will feature some new school stuff and some old school stuff. New Claw Machines, New Coin Pushers, a wood fired pizza food stand and a 18 hole indoor Putt Putt Golf course to start. There will be new pirate themed prizes at the prize counter and a bunch of pirate themed decorations complete with indoor ponds and waterfalls. One Eye's Billie himself will be working the prize booth as he is a "wheels on the ground" kinda leader. 

I'm working as hard as possible to have this first stage of One Eye's Billie's released by this Christmas.

The Second stage of One Eye'd Billie's will feature a Shooting gallery and a Radio Controlled pirate ship game on the indoor pond. These two areas will be under construction and closed off in the first version of One Eye'd Billie's. I am also working on a Pizza Delivery job that will give players another way to make some dough. (see what I did there?) These final pieces of One Eye'd Billie's are going to take a bit longer to finish so I will be adding them as they are completed. 

Multiplayer Timeline and info:
Yes. I am making a multiplayer but it will take time.

During the end of the summer/fall I started "testing and working" on multiplayer for The Coin Game. Its the main reason that One Eye'd Billie's is taking so long. I woke up one day and after reading the community thoughts about multiplayer, I just started to work on it. 

A month later I looked up from my keyboard and said to myself "I think I need to finish One Eye'd Billie's first and then come back to this later". As I realized It's going to be MUCH more work than I had anticipated. 

So far I have the multiplayer match making, text chatting, room/lobbies, menus and backend stuff almost complete but each game and machine will need to be upgraded and enhanced to function across a network. It is basically redoing part of each machine from scratch again. Lots of work but I know it will be worth it. I also want to add another vehicle or two before I build a system for riding around the island together. I'm guessing multiplayer with limited machines will be ready sometime Q2 2021. I hate to give dates so take these with a big grain of salt....lol.

As you can see I have built a small road side motel (See pics below) that will be a "spawn spot" for you and approx 6 of your friends in the future to pillage the island and reign as the Ticket Conquistadors (Or whatever you want to name your clan.) When you are in multiplayer, you will each have your own room in the motel as a "Home Base" as you will all be on vacation with your friends and not have access to the normal "Home" in Islandville. Don't worry. Uncle Phil said he knows the owner of the motel and will cover the cost. What a guy!

You will be able to just relax and play games with your friends at the arcades at your own speed. In fact, that's the main reason that I see the need for a multiplayer in The Coin Game. I think many people are lacking the ability to just go hang out with our friends at an arcade. Its going to take A LOT OF WORK but I am up for giving it my best shot. I am still in the early stages for multiplayer but I think I want to have a couple competitions and some challenges between vacation goers (players) and maybe even a Ticket Royale of some sort in the far future.

Well that's enough for now. I just wanted you all to know that I am working on it in the background. It is just going to take some more time. I will divulge more info as I am more sure of the direction that I am going in.

Hello fellow Islandville residents!

I have been pretty quiet and hard at work on the next location. It's coming along nicely so farrrrrgggGGHHHHH! Sorry. My pirate voice slipped out there. ;)

The next arcade/location coming to The Coin Game will be called "One Eye'd Billies". It's a Family Adventure and Indoor Fun Center that was inspired by the old road side fun centers all over the world. Bonus points if you can guess the original building that inspired this very old original Arcades front skull facade. 

Billie's is roughly 2 times the size of the UFO arcade. When it is finished, it will be located at the Mountain bus stop on the water near your home. It will have a wooden dock/pier that runs all the way around it on the water that I can expand on in the future if I need to. The coming area will feature a fun pirate theme and another full arcade with about a dozen or more new arcade machines and coin pushers, an 18 Hole indoor Putt Putt Golf Course, a couple of shooting galleries with goofy reactions for scoring a hit, Pizza take out/delivery area, a radio controlled boat pond and a pirate themed prize counter stuffed with all kinds of new treasures and prizes to collect or pawn off to Barry. 

I have also been working on a smaller update to Survivor Mode that will be coming before I have this next location complete. Some of the things I am working on for the next update are as follows.
 
- Sitting down mode: The ability to be able to sit on any chair or bench.
- Another vehicle or customizing the golf cart? Still not sure.... What do you all think?
- Tweaks to the Damage and Health systems.
- Tweaks to current machines

Things like new machines, putt putt golf, RC Boats and yummy stone fired pizzas. I will be showing more of these coming features as they get closer to completion in other dev blogs.

INDOOR EARLY MODELING TEASER PICS:

Here are some early work in progress pics from the interior of Billie's. You can see the mesh is not textured and only contains simple colors to "test" the layout. I like to build locations in a "raw form" like this first and then "test play it" to make sure it feels right. There is nothing like finishing an entire 3D building and then the fist time you play it you realize it sucks. haha. Each location goes through about 2-3 of these "nudge sessions". I sit there and play it. nudge it. Play it some more.... Nudge it. etc. At any given time there is about 4-5 major pieces of software open at one time just to work on one item. Its a crazy workflow nowadays but mainly I am usually just organizing files and folders. I sometimes think that is what most "game devs" do all day is make new folders and organize files for a living. haha. The modeling and coding for me is the easy part and time flies when I am doing that.

Many of the holes are inspired from the old side of the road smaller parks. No big overdone loo-pity loops or 100 foot drop offs here. I like to go for "realism" and things that would exist in a smaller town / population that would be working with a smaller budget. 

The arcades owner One Eye'd Billy isn't made of money and he is a simple Bot. He likes Wood Fired Pies (Pizzas) and a nice dockside sunset to charge his solar panels. He is also a heck of a sailor and the original captain of the ship that brought him and Uncle Phil to this wonderful place a long time ago. You can see the original wooden beauty on display in the harbor that he and Uncle Phil built with there own two hands.

He told me in an IslandMail the other day that he may even be into playing a few rounds of Putt Putt against you youngsters to show you who the real pirate is. More news on that later though. ;)

Aug 11th 2020

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/e668be2df924a7985ee5190ae8f917dc878442c4.jpg

UPDATE SUMMARY:
This update mainly addresses the "insta-death" from the bad bots or a random goose food item to the head. I have been watching many of your hilarious streams over the last few weeks and have seen way too many insta-deaths. I have made some changes to the way damage is dealt to the player and also at what times. Now the most damage you can get from an whipping item is about a 1/10th of what it was before. I turned all of the damage down on those items. This should eliminate the insta-deaths from holding items or falling down a hill and receiving a -50 damage. Now you will receive at the most a -10 Damage when falling off of a roof. Getting hit by a car will still kill you... so dont hang out in the road. In one of the future updates I plan on including damage when you are on the bike and Golf Cart. So start getting used to watching out more for traffic. 

Congrats to all of you veterans that played and LIVED through these rough and barbaric early times here on Islandville Isle. Well done. 

I made the bad bots "Short Circuit and burn up" now when you shoot them 3 times with a rubber band gun or even the Roman Candles. Shooting them 3 times will short circuit the bad bots and make them run to Larry's back door by the lambo to "heal up". This will give you more time to get to Barry's front door and be a little more "in control" around the pawn shop. I still have plans to add more "weapons" to battle them and also better "burning up" animations for the bad guys but that will come at a later date. ;)

I also turned down the "constant declining health" system a bit. Now your health will only drop quickly if you are really low on energy. I am still working on a "low energy and health" visual warning system that will come in the next phase of Survivor Mode beta.

You can also check in to go to bed 2 hours earlier now. 7 PM instead of 9 PM the blankets in your bed will now be open. This should also ease the health drain a bit and allow you to get some rest a little bit earlier and refresh yourself.

I am still working on a Dev blog with some early teasers for the next location. One Eye'd Billies Fun and Adventure Center. I will have the blog post ready very soon with a little road map for some of the coming games and even some ideas for future development. So stay tuned.

That's about all I have for this small patch update. You may notice a couple more small patch updates coming to keep adjusting the new beta Survivor Mode. 

Thank you to all of you for all the support. I could not do this without ALL OF YOU!

Kevin


UPDATE PATCH NOTES:

DAMAGE SYSTEM:
- Turned off the player damage system when using the Karting System and Lazer Tag systems.
- Turned off the player damage system when you are holding an item to stop the killing yourself when trying to feed Gary/Fish or manipulate other things.

 -50 = High Damage

New Values

- Deactivate the bikes wheel colliders sooner to stop the bikes wheels from interfering with the player controller and sending you to the moon. 


CURFEW:
- You can now check in 2 hours earlier and go to sleep to get that needed boost of health. The bed "covers" will open at 7 PM instead of 9 PM now.


BARRYS:
- Fixed a bug in Barry's that would allow the player to eat an item and still get paid for it. Now the menu and system will auto update when changed.
- Fixed a bug with the Barry's "Hot item" System not displaying the proper names.

- Rebuilt the bad bots and how they respond to being shot. You can also now "stop" them with fireworks. Hit them three times to make them "retreat".
- Added more locations for the "bad bots" to randomly visit around Barry's area to help spread out the "presence" of them at the front door of Barry's.

- Rubber bands can damage the bad bots and deactivate them for about 30 seconds as they are "burning up". (Work In Progress)



MISC:

- Fixed some Random Items that were not spawning on the Dollar store roof.

notes.content:
June 8th 2020

Survivor mode is released! How many days will you last?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32533218/ecf913df8fc7222f302d360cecd8c3e3516e15a5.jpg


I am so happy to bring this update to The Coin Game! Thank you so much for all the support and patience through all of these crazy times we are all going through. I have been building and updating this game for over a year and a half now and I have loved every second. The community and users here are the best I have ever encountered.... and I am not just saying that. I really love the way people treat and help each other around here. Its nice to see.... So first off I want to say THANK YOU to all that have helped others out, helped me out, bug fixed, suggested ideas, suggested machines, ideas...etc. Thank you very much and I hope you enjoy the next stage of The Coin Game as much as I enjoyed creating it for you. I have a long way to go but I am glad that you all make it so easy and pleasant. :)

First off please remember that this is a WORK IN PROGRESS and is not finished. I am releasing the Survivor Mode Beta a bit early as I want you all involved and to get more feedback from the community. In the next week there will be plenty of Patch fixes and more builds coming. I will make a new thread for just Survivor Mode Beta Bugs. Thank you VERY MUCH for all your help and support.

I am going to be rolling out the new Survivor Mode in a few stages. This first stage includes the new health and energy systems along side of more ways to make money. As this is Survivor mode and not Birthday mode, you will be earning your own way instead of being spoiled by rich Uncle Phil. You must also manage a curfew from Mom and Nanny bot. Nanny bot does not mess around and if she has to come get you, you are "grounded" and it's game over.  

This initial release of Survivor Mode "Beta Stage One" is a way for me to gather data and feedback from all of you on the new mode. It is not finished and is in a "Work In Progress" state. I have left features out of this first stage for now that are still getting polished and optimized but the base of the new mode is there. I will be changing things based on the communities feedback and ideas.... So let me hear it. WE ARE BUILDING THIS TOGETHER. I dont know how this is going to play out and I am ready to be nimble and adapt. I want it to be fun but not daunting. Finding the right level of game difficulty in a survivor mode is a fine line and as a single dev its hard to balance so many variables and systems at one time. So what I have done is built all of the needed systems and have inserted base starting points/values. I have been playing and testing in house for months but I am sure we are going to be changing and tuning it more. I am very much excited about this part. Its all new and kind of uncharted waters for myself and this genre. So I am going to be counting on you all to help me out with more of those amazing ideas that you all come up with.  Ok... enough babbling. 

Hows does Survivor Mode work?

TLDR: Survivor Mode Curfew Times:
- Day wake up start time = 7:00 AM
- Can check in and go to sleep time = 9:00 PM
- MUST be home or you are grounded time = 11:00 PM

You will now start the day at around 7:00 AM in the morning in your bedroom. For now the day will be a set length but in the future when the XP Points system is finished you will then be able to purchase a later curfew and other small advantages to help you around the island. Again, that will come in a later update. You will begin the initial day with about $2.50 in spending cash, some food in the fridge and some supplies around the home. You can play out the day however you wish as long as you are home by the curfew time that you can track on the onscreen hud or on your smart watch (its the blue ring on the Player hud). There are also some new jobs around the island to earn spending money. You can now babysit the Jones family baby bots, mow Barry's home lawn, deliver newspapers or even take back shopping carts at the Dollar Store.

You must be IN THE HOUSE when the curfew timer hits 0:00 or you are grounded and its Game Over. You will be warned by the curfew timer that will flash in your player HUD in the last hour of time remaining. You can go to sleep anytime after about 9:00 PM to start a new day sooner if you wish. You can tell that its time to go to sleep as the nightlight next to your bed will turn on and the covers on the bed in your room will "open up" and allow you to click the pillows to go to sleep. You will get a health and energy boost for sleeping but your Energy will be a bit lower than your health in the mornings. Make sure to eat something to get your energy up to speed in the morning.

The new Health, Energy and Curfew system in Survivor Mode adds a little more excitement to getting around the island. You must keep your energy level up by eating some junk food throughout the day (or you will move and walk slower) but also must manage your overall health to stay "alive". If you let your energy level drop too low it will start to take away health so make sure to keep them both up and maintained. In the new Survivor Mode you can get injured by vehicles, mean bots yielding bats and Rubber band guns and even falling/jumping off of points that are too high. If your health falls below 0 you will pass out and Nanny bot has to come take care of you. ie; You are Grounded and it's Game Over.

Again... This is still a work in progress and Survivor Mode will be getting tweaked and changed throughout the Early Access stage.
